messages:
maria: deploy-bot finished canary rollout for release/v2.3.4 -> starting mini-smoke probes :rocket:
alex: seeing p95 up to 820ms on embed-synth in eu-west1, a couple 524 timeouts
cheng: which probe id? paste a couple log lines if you have them
maria: probe-id=mini-replay-2026-03-23-01
maria: logs: `2026-03-23T01:12:05Z mini-replay: req=12345 p95=820ms status=200` `2026-03-23T01:12:09Z mini-replay: req=12346 p95=260ms status=200`
alex: looks like a transient fanout on host-group-7 (eu-west1), queue depth shows spikes
jon: recommend we hold global promotion and pin traffic back to v2.3.3 for top-10 customers until triage
cheng: +1, also set deploy-bot canary to PAUSE so no auto-promotion
maria: executing: `deploy-bot pin --version v2.3.3 --scope top10` and `deploy-bot pause-promotion canary`
deploy-bot: action accepted — canary promotion paused; pin v2.3.3 applied
sre-oncall: pulling traces now, will check KV cache warmup and GC events for host-group-7
alex: found GC spikes on host-7 around 01:11-01:13, pushing heap dump to s3://redwood-dumps/heap-1767012345
jen: do we want to open a rollback ticket? release notes called out tokenizer fixes but nothing about cache behavior
jon: don't roll back yet. Try a soft fallback first: route ~10% to quant-variant and shorten batch window to reduce tail
maria: adding circuit-breaker/fallback rule: route-fallback -> quant-v2.3.4-q8 for eu-west1
cheng: starting quick canary rerun against the synthetic set (same flows), ETA ~6m
alex: if rerun passes, we can consider resuming promotion but keep the v2.3.3 pin for 30m as a safety net
maria: updated release notes with a short line about tokenizer retry/backoff tweak and the temporary pin decision
jen: pinged CS and PM to let top10 accounts know about the temporary pin and that we're on it
sre-oncall: quick triage: heap dump shows minor GC bursts + tokenizer thread lock contention aligning with the p95 tail
jon: plan = hold promotion, keep pin for 30m, dig deeper on GC/lock path, prepare hotpatch if needed
maria: ack — updating #release-updates and the release doc with current state and mitigation steps
maria: /remind #eng-releases in 30 minutes to re-evaluate canary :bell:
alex: :thumbsup:
cheng: thanks all, monitoring continues
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 1767014145 to re-evaluate canary
